lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd4Sc2Sn4 (reduced formula Nd2ScSn2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/nmm (No. 119), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies 8-coordinate Nd environments, including a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement of 4 Nd and 4 Sn neighbors, while Sc centers show 10 neighbors and Sn centers show 6. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Nd 8-vertex polyhedra, corner- and edge-sharing between Nd and Sn polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Nd and Sc polyhedra.
